'ungag dbang ye shes kyis brtsams/mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

dpe srun gsal bshad/〈dung sgra〉zhes pa'i snyan rtsom 'di ni sku zhabs ngag dbang ye shes lags nas ljags rtsom gnang ba zhig yin gshis/ snyan rtsom 'di'i nang khong gis lo shas nang chos zhor du ljags rtsom gnang ba'i bstod pa dang / snyan tshigabaslab bya/ bshad pa/ mthong thos myong gsum nas byung ba'i dran 'char/ de bzhin brtsams sgrung sogs rtsom yig khag cig bsdus yod pa la/ rtsom so so'i yig tshogs de tsam mang po med rung brjod par 'dod pa'i don gnad khag rnams gsal rjen dang ji ma ji bzhin du bkod 'dug pa la rtsom yig so so'i nyams 'gyur legs pa dang / rgyan du bkod pa rnams gnad la 'phigs pa/dgod bro ba/ klog pa po'i yid du 'thad pa/ rtsom hril po'i tshig sbyor yangs pa/ brjod don khag rnams don dngos kyi 'tsho ba dang 'brel ba yod pa/brjod par 'dod pa'i gnas tshul khag klog pa pos tshegs med du shes rtogs thub pa la sogs pa'i khyad chos phun sum tshogs pa zhig 'dug lhag par du mi'i gting gshis kyi ngo lkog dang rgyab mdun/ bden rdzun/ dga' skyo la sogs pa'i blo'i snang 'char dang rang bzhin rnams ji bzhin drang por brjod 'duga'adis gcig nas rtsom pa po yag po zhig byed dgos na nges par du 'tsho ba dngos kyi nyams myong yod dgos pa dang / gnyis nas gang des brtsams pa'i brjod bya'i don rnams 'tsho ba dngos kyi nang nas byung ba zhig dang /gsum nas rjod byed kyi tshig sbyor khag rnams go bde la brjod bya khag kha gsal 1

por ston thub pa zhig byung na des gzhi nas klog pa po'i yid dbang 'gug thub pa'i dpe mtshon bzang po zhig ston 'dugagang ltar 'dis klog pa po'i yid dbang 'gug thub pa tsam ma zad/rang rigs kyi rtsom la dga' ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la ji ltar byas te snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i tshig sbyor la 'jug pa'i dpe gzhi yag po zhig chags thub rgyu red 'dug pas da lam 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas dpar du bskrun pa la dpe sgrig zhu phyogs dang par gzhi sgrig stangs sogs kyi thad dag min gyi nyes skyon du ma yod nges pas rgya che'i klog pa po rnams nas legs nyes blang dor dang dgongs 'char lhug stsol yong ba'i skyabs 'jug zhu rgyu dang bcas/mi rigs dpe skrun khang nas/

bod la mtshon na'ang 'dra/bod kyi shes rig la mtshon na'ang 'dra/bod yig yongs khyab bed spyod gtong rgyu dang /chos lugs kyi srid jus lag len yag po bstar rgyu/7kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po ches/dad brtson shes ldan blo gsal rkang drug rnams/lung rigs 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i dga' tshal du/rtag 'grus brtson pa'i gshog rtsal la brten nas/gnas lnga rig pa'i rtsi bcud myong bar 'bungs/7skyabs rje cog grwa rin po ches/

dkar chagasdings che dgon gyi bkod pa ngo mtshar shel gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ ( 1 )gar 'cham la bstod pa/ ( 4 )blon chen mgar ba stong btsan/ ( 5 )bden rdzun dris pa/ ( 6 )mtha' ma ( 7 )ka phreng lcags kyi tsher ma/ ( 8 )rnam 'gyur gyi khe gyong / (10)mthong thos myong gsum/ (12)zhwa nag (15)mi re'i sems la nga'o nga rgyal re/ (16)mi tshe'i lta ba/ (18)bstod smon sems kyi sgra dbyangs/ (20)gtam rgyud tasbra ra/ (21)rtsom la dga' ba'i grogs po tsho/ (30)grogs bzang po'i rin thang bsam las 'das/ (31)dran 'char/ (33)'char snang tho bkod lhu bsgrigs/ (34)char dus kyi chu skyes/ (41)snyan ngag yod/ (42)1

kha btags dkar po/ (44)'dra re che/ (45)dbyangs bzhi/ (46)gsal byed sum cu/ (47)gab cirdog khag bzhi/ (48)dung sgra/ (49)rgya mtsho dang ded dpon chung chung / (50)grwa rkyang tsho/ (51)brtse gdung gi gshed ma/ (53)sgor mo'i gtam/ (54)lus dang sems/ (55)me lce/ (56)dran gdung gi 'bod sgra/ (57)kho gnyis gnyis ka pham song (58)gra nang gi mkhas pa mi bzhi/ (59)snyan ngag don rgyan so lnga'i dper brjod gzhon nu'i lam zhes pa'i mtshams sbyor rags bsdus/ (61)spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur ni mi'i bsam pa'i 'gyur ba kho na yin/ (64)bstod tshig thi'u gsum brtsegs/ (69)mjug bsdu ba'i gtam/ (70)2

sdengs che dgon gyi bkod pa ngo mtshar shel gyi phreng ba zhes bya ba/oṃ su ste/ / las bzhi lhun grub o rgyan pad+ma dang / / stod 'brug ston pa'i bu chen yang dgon pa/ / dus 'khor mnga' bdag rin chen dpal bzang sogs/ / sdings che'i gdan rabs bla ma rnams la 'dud/ / g.yo ru grwa yi sdings po che zhes kun la yongs su grags pa yi/ / gnas mchog de yi phyi nang bkod pa'i ngo mtshar rgya mtsho chen po las/ / chu thigs tsam zhig rang blos gzhal ba skye bo kun gyi snyan lam du/ / brjod par 'dod la snyan tshig med kyang rang gi dad sems mtshon par bya/ / nam mkha' sngo zhing dwangs ba'i dbus/ / sprin dkar gdugs ltar phubs pa'i 'og / bsam pa'i don kun rab tu grub/ / mthong pa'i mod la smon pa'i dgon/ / 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sku pang nang / / bzhugs pa ji bzhin mngon par chags/ / gzi brjid 'bar ba'i gtsug lag khang / / lha yi pho brang 'phos 'dra ba'i/ / rtse mor ri dwags chos 'khor dang / / gser mdog rgyal mtshan 'od du 'tsher/ / mdun du chos ra sgar gseb kyi/ / khod snyoms spang gshongs nyams dga' des/ /dri med g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal mtshon/ / de na bsam gtan pa yi khang / / yid 'ong cog sgar shel phreng bzhin/ / mdzes pa'i mtha' na 'bras ldan shing / / rlung gis dal bur g.yo ba'i tshe/ / 'bras bu thur du lhung ba des/ / ting nge 'dzin 1

yang dkrog par byed/ / g.yas kyi dwangs gatreng chu mig la/ / 'dab ldan shing sna mang pos skor/ rgyab na ngo mtshar can gyi gnas/ / shin tu mtho ba'i g.yu sgong brag / rgyang nas ltas na dung dkar 'dra/ / rtse mor mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal phug / bar na o rgyan gu ru'i phug / de 'og thang dkar rgod po'i tshang / / gu ru'i phug na slob dpon gyis/ / 'gro ba rnams la dad pa'i rten/ / sra 'khregs brag la'ang 'jim pa bzhin/ / zhabs kyis brdzis nas zhabs rjes bzhag / ya mtshan rmad byung zhabs kyi rjes/ / da lta'i dus na'ang dngos su bzhugs/ / dgon gyi g.yon na skyi g.ya' ba/ / mi sha khrag rus skam rnying rlon/ / so dang skra spu la sogs pa/ / phyogs dang phyogs su 'thor ba las/ / dri ma ngan pa thul ba sogs/ / ya nga'i dur khrod 'jigs rung de/ /mi rtag 'chi ba'i skul mar sems/ / dbus su brjid chags gzi byin 'bar ba'i gtsug lag khang / / de yi nang du spyan ras gzigs dbang sprul ba'i gar/ / dpal ldan cog gra 'gro ba'i mgon dang bshes gnyen tshogs/ / dad gus ldan pa'i slob ma'i 'khor bcas gzhung lugs la/ / 'chad nyan gru char gdul bya'i zhing sar gsos su sman/ / lta ba ngan pas log pa'i bstan bcos bcos tha dag la/ / tshig don gnyis gas bsun 'byin gnam lcags thogs ltar 'phen/ / dpyad 'jog spel dang zung 'jug sgom pa'i nyams len gyis/ / chos nyid stong pa phyag rgya chen po'i klong du ā/ / tshig gi me tog sna tshogs las/ / btus pa'i snyan ngag sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ / snyan ldan mgron por 'gyed pa na/ / tshim zhing mgu ba'i rnam 'gyur te/ / 'dzum bzhin 'dzum bzhin legs so yā/ / gzhan yang sngon byon mes po tsho'i/ / rig pa'i rtsal las thon pa yi/ / nang rten byin chags khyad du 'phags/ / grangs med bzhugs pa'i ngo mtshar dag / mtha' dag brjod 'dod ngal ba'i rgyu/ /gnas mchog sdings che'i cog sgar gyi/ / lung rigs smra ba'i dga' tshal 2

gar 'cham la bstod pa/dpal ldan cog sgar 'dus pa'i sde chen por/ /slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i mdzad phrin las/ /zhi chags khro bo'i lha yi rnam pa ru/ /brdzus nas yi dam ting 'dzin ma bral bar/ /gar gyi nyams 'gyur dgu dang ldan pa yi/ /rig pa'i sgyu rtsal mi nyams spel bas na/ /ngo mtshar ltad mo mig gi bdud rtsi des/ /dad ldan rnams la byin rlabs cis mi 'jug /ces bod rang byung bcu bdun me khyi lo'i bod zla bzhi pa'i sdings che'i 'cham sbyongs chen mo'i nyin sbyar ba dge /ri zhe ste6geshāri— — ༷rī53 4

blon chen mgar ba stong btsan/rnam dkar lhag bsam gangs kyi ri la 'gran/ / ma g.yengs rnam shes nyi zla ji bzhin gzigs/ / btsan po'i sku srog rkun po'i lag nas blangs/ /mdzangs blon mgar ba stong btsan yul bzung dran/ / rje yi bka' bkod gnam gyi char ltar drangs/ / 'bangs kyi re 'bod chu mig sa nas bton/ /chu gnyis srid kyi rdzing bur gcig sgyur byas/ / blon chen mgar ba stong btsan yul zung dran/ / rgya bod mdza' mthun 'brel lam gtod pa'i phyir/ / 'dzam gling mkhas dgu rnams dang rigs pa 'gran/ / mdzangs ma rgya bza' kong jo bod la bsus/ / mdzangs blon mgar ba stong btsan yul bzung dran/ /thabs shes zung du 'brel ba'i 'khor lo bskor/ / mtha' bzhi'i dgra btul rgyal khams dbang du bsdus/ / bod kyi chab srid mnga' thang dgung la bteg /blon chen mgar ba stong btsan yul bzung dran/ yi ge ma shes na yang rnam dpyod la/ / mkhas pa mang pos 'gran zla ma 'chis pa'i/ / snyan grags gtam gyi dar chen bod la gtsugs/ / mdzangs blon mgar ba stong btsan yul bzung dran/ / gzhan rtsal thob dang go sa ma bzhes par/ / la rgya'i rwa co 'khregs po gung la kyer/ / dpa' mdzangs stobs gsum bod la legs skyes phul/ / blon chen mgar ba stong btsan yul bzung dran/ / g.yo can khram pas phra ma'i bsnyon btsugs kyang / / spyang po'i shugs kyis bden pa'i mkha' la 'phur/ / bden pa'i rgyal kha gzhan la mi sprod pa'i/ /mdzangs blon mgar ba stong btsan yul zung dran/ /5

bden rdzun dris pa/bden pa su yin dris pa na/ / kun gyis nga yin nga yin zer/ / rdzun pa su zhes dris pa na/ / tshang mas nga min nga min zer/ / thams cad bden pa yin gyur na/ / rdzun pa'i go sa gang na yod/ / rang gi khe phan sgrub tsa na/ /bden pa yin zer khyed kyang rdzun/ / thams cad rdzun pa yin gyur na/ /bden pa'i go sa ga na yod/ / rang la khe gyong med pa na/ / g.yo can khyed kyang bden pa'i phyogs/ / bden rdzun dbye ba ma chod pa'i/ / za ri zi ri'i 'jig rten 'dir/ / bya rog 'ug pa'i rtsod pa bzhin/ / bden rdzun gnyis kar rgyal pham mang / / bden pas rgyal na rgyal ba yin/ / ming don mtshungs pa'i rgyal kha yin/ / rdzun pa pham na pham pa red/ / pham pa'i nang nas pham pa red/ /

mtha' ma/deng dus rdzun la dga' ba'i pho mo tshos/ / rdzun gyi 'khor lo bar mtshams med pa skor/ / mtha' ma rdzun gyi 'khor los rang mgo bshag rdzun gyi 'khor lo de la skor tshod mdzod/ /g.yo rgyu khram la dga' ba'i pho mo tshos/ / g.yo sgyu khram pa'i zlos gar rgyun du 'khrab/ / mtha' ma g.yo khram de yis rang mtshang rtol/ / g.yo rgyu'i zlos gar de la 'khrab tshod mdzod/ /rang rlom lta ba mtho ba'i pho mo tshos/ / gzhan gyi legs cha mthong bar gnod sems skye/ / mtha' ma rang nyes lci bas 'khun sgra 'don/ / phrag dog gnod sems 'khur du 'khyer tshod mdzod/ /thung thung mi tshe 'di yi skad cig la/ / zing zing 'khrugs long thug pa bzhin du 'khol/ / mtha' ma thug pas bzi nas rang mgo thoms/ / 'khrugs long thug pa 'di la skol tshod mdzod/ /7

ka phreng lcags kyi cher ma/ka yi mes po bdag la gson dang deng dus dpyad gtam spel mkhan 'ga' yis/ / kha nas rigs gzhung nyams pa slar gso mi nyams gong spel gtong dgos zer yang / / ga ler srol rgyun rnying hrul red ces mi 'dod rnam 'gyur ston gyi 'dug pas/ / nga yi sems na de tsho spyang ki lug spags gyon pa min nam rnyam mo/ / ca co mang smra'i rnying zhen can 'gas lugs rnying thams cad dag par 'dzin zhing / / cha lugs mthun pa'i gsar gtod mkhan la mi 'thad bsun 'byin ltar snang brjod po/ / ja ro lta bu btsir yang legs bshad khu ba gsar pa don du med pa/ / nya nad phog pa'i phyug dang mtshungs rnams gzig lpags g.yog pa'i bong bur sems so/ / ta la'i ljon par sdong po med na yal ga gsar pa gang las brgyas sam/ / tha mal 'ga' yis gsar dang rnying pa mthun thabs med pa'i lta tshul bzung ste/ / da lta dpyad gtam spel ba de ko dam pa'i tshul las 'das pa'i phyir na/ / na kha spo mtho de yi steng du legs bshad chu rgyun 'khyil lam snyam mo/ / pa ṭu 'ga' yis snyan ngag yon tan go bde 'dzin sla yin zhes smras kyang / pha rol gzhan 'gas go dka' tshig mkhreg snyan ngag yon tan yin no zer lo/ / ba nyal mdzo grod bdag gis bltas na brjod bde 'dzin sla rgyan nyams ldan pa/ / ma 'khrul yon tan nyid du 'dod la rigs pa'i gnod byed med par sems so/ / tsa na yin yang rnam dpyod ldan pa'i tshan rigs mkhan po'i gzhung lugs yang dag / tsha grang ji 8

bzhin dam pa'i chos dang 'gal bar gyur pa ga la yin srid/ / dza ya'i bstan dang deng rabs tshan rig gzu por gnas pa'i blo yi sgo nas/ / wa ler bltas na de gnyis phan tshun me dang rlung bzhin min nam snyam mo/ / zha long 'dra ba'i blun po rnams ni rang rlom che 'dod nga rgyal mtho zhing / / za 'thung longs spyod mtshan snyan ched du zhi bde'i sad la me ru spar 'gro/ / 'a cag mi yi dbang po rnams kyis srog las zhi bde gces par 'dod pas/ / ya rabs mkhas dang ma rabs blun po lag len bya bas 'gal 'dur sems so/ / rwa ltar gyong ba'i sems kyi rgyud can mngon sum don la snyon du btsugs nas/ / la lung dus kyis lkog tu gyur pa'i gnad la 'grel bshad rab rib rgyag mkhan/ / sha tshugs mi yi rnam dpyod ldan pa dngos gtso smra ba'i gral las phud de/ / sa steng 'di na sems gtso smra ba'i gral du'ang 'jug pa mi rigs snyams mo/ / ha cang mi mthun 'gal 'du'i lta bar brtag zhib dpyad nas dgag bzhag byed rgyu/ / a ma'i o lo'i rig pa'i sgo mo yangs por 'byed pa'i thabs shes dam pa/ / ha las dgos pa 'di min gzhan zhig srid pa gsum na mchis pa min zhes/ / a ma'i bu ngas g.yar dam bca' la mi 'thad thal bas stong par sems so//9

rnam 'gyur gyi khe gyong /khyim sdod kyi zhi mi sder mo rno/ /tsi tsi yi mgo bo kha la bzung / /brjid nyams kyi skad sgra sgrog bzhin du/ /yus che ba'i sgo nas bdag por blta/ /khyim sdod kyi zhi mi rnam dpyod grung / /bdag po yi mdun du snyan sgra dang / /dga' gus kyi rnam 'gyur bstan pas na/ /byams skyong gi khe phan rang la thob/ /khyim sdod kyi sgo khyi 'jigs su rung / /dgra rkun gyi lam po kho yis bkag /rdzig rdzig gi skad sgra sgrogs bzhin du/ /khang khyim la rtag tu srung skyob byed/ /khyim sdod kyi sgo khyi zhe sdang che/ /mthong tshad kyi mi la kha dgra bsags/ /spyod rtsub kyi rnam 'gyur bstan pas na/ /rdo dbyug gi gyong gun rang la phog /khyim sdod kyi bong bu stobs shugs che/ /sbyin bdag gi 'khur chen rgyab tu 'khyer/ /dka' las dang ngal dub khyad du bsad/ /10

dbor 'dren gyi las la rtag tu 'bad/ /khyim sdod kyi bong bu shin tu glen/ /spyang grung gi rnam shes kho la med/ /mkhas mkhas dang snyan snyan ma shes pas/ /mthong chung dang brnyas bcos byed mkhan mang / /2 0 rkya1 〈 5nyin// —lte ci shā tsho1/ri 7 ’ rnyidarngo ༈7 (rdzobheyo ne+e sh+lauchodz+wa(54 shaṃdīlho/ ci / ju/rdo/ngano/ga —— casna5dusasuXri / — ri ri / — / ni ji ri /sdu 74sna lto rī 99 nga sdo

mthong thos myong gsum/dkar mdzes hrī yig las 'khrungs/ / mtsho byung dbyangs kyi lha mo/ / mi tshe'i bzlos gar 'di la/ / phyi ltas lan gcig gzigs dang / /bsam bsam bde ba bsam pa/ / skye bo kun gyi sems nyid/ / bde dang sdug bsngal 'dres pa/ / 'jig brten 'khor ba'i chos nyid/ /re ba re sgug byed dus/ / dmigs yul la mo'i pha rgyab/ / dogs pas bya ra byed dus/ / rkyen ngan 'khris la bsdad 'dug /'khon pa'i dgra bo zhig gis/ / rdo zhwa g.yogs rang ma byung / / gya gyu can gyi grogs pos/ / thang khug g.yogs par yong gi /ma ṇi kha nas 'dren rgyu/ / bsam ngan sems la bcangs rgyu/ / kha dang sems kyi bar la/ / rgyab 'gal tag tag song 'dug /ji 'dra'i grogs po zhig gis/ / thug pa dkrugs kyang dkrugs song / /thug pa btungs kyang btungs so/ / thug pas bzi yang bzi 'dug /dga' 'dod byams pa'i ched du/ / skyo ngag mig chu lhung lhung / / skyid 'dod lus po'i ched du/ / dka' ngal rngul chu 'dzar 'dzar/ /dga' ba'i ched du skyo ba/ / skyid po'i ched du sdug bsngal/ / ldog phyogs dang du len par/ / nga rang gad mo shor byung / /lnga gsum bco lnga'i bar du/ / pha ma'i drin gyis bskyangs byung / / bco lnga'i la mo'i rtse nas/ / gshog rtsal ngom ste 'phur yod/ /12

gshog zung mkha' la brkyang nas/ / lding skor lan gsum brgyab ste/ /drin can pha ma'i phyogs la/ / phyir ltas lan gsum slog yod/ /drin can drin can zer ba'i/ / tshig la dpyad pa byas nas/ / drin can pha ma'i bka' drin/ / 'jal ba'i dam bca' bzhag yod/ /nyin mo gcig song gnyis song / / lo zla myur por rdzogs 'gro/ / rta las mgyogs pa'i dus kyis/ / nga la tshab sha bslang byung / /phyi yi lus po 'di la/ / na tsha gang yong mi 'dug / nang gi sems pa 'di la/ / sdug bsngal gang yong mi 'dug /lus sems bde ba'i dus su/ / kha nas glu chung blangs yod/ / sems pa skyo ba'i dus su/ / ngu snying gting nas 'dod byung / /mi yul skyid sdug 'dres ma/ / mthong snang sems kyi 'char sgo/ / skyid dus bde chen zhing khams/ / sdug dus dmyal khams bco brgyad/ /mtshan mo mun pa rub dus/ / dkar gsal zla ba dran byung / / tsha bas yongs su gdung dus/ / zla ba'i bsil zer dran byung / /gnam la skar gral 'grigs kyang / / zla ba ma gtogs mi dgos/ / sa steng mi yis khengs kyang / / blo dkar ma gtogs mi dgos/ /sha khrag rus pa'i lus po/ / sems kyi g.yog po yin na/ / legs nyes bya ba thams cad/ / sems la bka' dri gnang rogs/ /sems ni sems kyi g.yog yin/ / sems ni sems kyi dpon yin/ /sems pa ngan la shor dus/ / sems pas sems pa gcun rogs/ /yod kyang chog shes med pa/ / 'byor ldan tshong pa'i 'dod pa/ / med kyang yod mdog kha po/ / 'byor med dbul po'i chog shes/ /'byor ldan gtong phod med na/ / yi dwags mdzod kyi bdag po/ /dbul po 'tshol sems med pa/ / bong bu las kyang skyo ba/ /13

rang sems rang gis bkyag ste/ / mthon po'i nga rgyal ma sgom/ / rang sems nang la bkug nas/ / bsam zhib glu ru len dang / /mkhas rnams khengs dregs spangs te/ / dam tshig gtsug tu blangs nas/ / spyod bzang kun la spel phyir/ / zhi dul glu zhig len dang / /a mchod sems pa g.yengs nas/ / rnga 'chol drag tu ma brdung / / rtse gcig yi dam bsgoms nas/ / chos kyi glu zhig len dang / /dpon rnams sger sems bcangs te/ / za sgo'i yi dam ma bsgom/ /dmangs don phrag tu blangs nas/ / dpa' bo'i glu zhig len dang / /bzang ngan bya ba'i bar la/ / bstod smad mi kha'i rgyal pham/ / nyin dang mtshan mo'i bar la/ / bya rog 'ug pa'i rgyal pham/ /khyi ngan ku co 'don par/ / rgyu mtshan gang zhig yod dam/ / khrag dog can gyi mi khar/ / rgyu mtshan gang yang mi 'dug /'brugagi stong sgra de la/ / skrags nas snying rtsa 'dar na/ / dbyar kha spang ri'i steng nas/ / skyid glu len thabs mi 'dug /rang 'dod me ru spar dus/ / nga rang tsan dan sdong po/ / mi kha'i ser ba bab dus/ / nga rang rdo rje'i brag yin/ /14

zhwa nagarnam dpyod spyang grung med pa'i glen pa ni/ /g.yo can khram pa'i mig nang bong bu bzhin/ /kho yi gsang ba'i ngan spyod 'khur po dag /mi kha'i do por byas nas glen par bskur/ /khur po ma theg 'khun sgra shor la nye/ /kye ma nga dang 'dra ba'i glen pa tshor/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs brje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /ma nyes mi kha'i zhwa nag bud par shog /nga 'dra'i 'gro ba gti mug glen rtags can/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i gnyid las rab sad nas/ /bzang ngan skye bo'i ngo ris ngo ma de/ /gsal gsal rjen rjen bdag gis mthong bar shog /15

mi re'i sems la nga'o nga rgyal re/mi re'i sems la nga'o nga rgyal re/ /rig gzhung smra bar mkhas pa'i sems khongs na/ /bdag gi rnam dpyod 'di la zla med snyam/ /skye bo gzhan las rang nyid lhag par sgom/ /mi re'i sems la nga 'o nga rgyal re/ /'byor ldan phyug po zhig gi sems khongs na/ /bdag gi dpal 'byor 'di la zla med snyam/ /skye bo gzhan las rang nyid lhag par sgom/ /mi re'i sems la nga 'o nga rgyal re/ /dbang chen dpon po zhig gi sems khongs na/ /bdag gi dbang shugs 'di la zla med snyam/ /skye bo gzhan las rang nyid lhag par sgom/ /mi re'i sems la nga 'o nga rgyal re/ /dbang med 'byor med zhig gi sems khongs na/ /blo bde bag phebs bdag la zla med snyam/ /skye bo gzhan las rang nyid lhag par sgom/ /mi re'i sems la nga 'o nga rgyal re/ /stag shar gzhon pa zhig gi sems khongs na/ /16

bdag gi bshed shugs 'di la zla med snyam/ /skye bo gzhan las rang nyid lhag par sgom/ /mi re'i sems la nga 'o nga rgyal re/ /na chung bu mo zhig gi sems khongs na/ /bdag gi lang tsho'i mdzes sdug zla med snyam/ /skye bo gzhan las rang nyid lhag par sgom/ /mi re'i sems la nga 'o nga rgyal re/ /bden brdzun 'dres ma'i mi yi sems khongs na/ / g.yo sgyu ham pa tsha na spyang grung dang / /bden pa'i gzhung la srang na glen pa zer/ /mi re'i sems la nga 'o nga rgyal re/ / mkhas blun 'dres ma'i mi yi sems khongs na/ /zog po 'ur bshod mkhan la mkhas pa dang / /dam pa nyams len mkhas la'ang glen pa zer/ /17

mi che'i lta ba/shes bya rig gzhung kun la sbyangs pa dgos/ /lo bcu'i gong nas 'bri klog shes pa dgos/ /'bri klog bsam med byis pa'i shes bya yin/ /byis pa chung nas 'bri klog shes pa dgos/ /shes bya rig gzhung kun la sbyangs pa dgos/ /nyi shu'i gong nas dag snyan sum shes dgos/ /bsam gzhigs gsar 'tshol byis pa'i shes bya yin/ /byis pa'i dus nas snyan ngag 'bri shes dgos/ /shes bya rig gzhung kun la sbyangs pa dgos/ /sum cu'i gong nas ched las byang chub dgos/ /bya bzhag ngos 'dzin gzhon nu'i shes bya yin/ /gzhon nu'i dus nas bya bzhag gtan 'khel dgos/ /shes bya rig gzhung kun la mkhas pa dgos/ /bzhi bcu'i gong nas bya bzhag legs bsgrub dgos/ /gang la'ang zhum med dar ma'i stobs shugs yin/ /dar ma'i dus nas rang sa zin pa dgos/ /shes bya rig gzhung kun la mkhas pa dgos/ /lnga bcu'i gong nas gzhan phan las byed dgos/ /rgas por brtsi bkur thob pa gzhan phan yin/ /dar ma'i dus nas gzhan phan ngom rgyu dgos/ /18

shes bya rig gzhung kun la mkhas pa dgos/ /drug cu'i gong nas phyi ma'i lam shes dgos/ /'di phyi'i sa mtshams drug cu'i mtshams nas yin/ /'jig rten phyi mar 'gro ba'i grabs zin dgos/ /shes bya rig gzhung kun la mkhas pa dgos/ /bdun cu'i gong nas kha smras nyung ba dgos/ /kha dgra sna dgra rgas po'i phungs dgra yin/ /rgas por bsod nams can gyi bzhugs stangs dgos/ /shes bya rig gzhung kun la mkhas pa dgos/ /kun tu ya rabs spyod bzung rgyud la dgos/ /g.yo khram mgo bde pham kha nyo mkhan yin/ /mi la drang bden zhum med stobs shugs dgos/ /shes bya rig gzhung kun la mkhas pa dgos/ /lha chos mi chos gnyis la mkhas pa dgos/ /lha chos mi chos rang gzhan gnyis phan yin/ /rang gzhan gnyis phungs las la 'dzem bya dgos/ /de skad mi tshe'i rgyud rim mtha' 'khyongs na/ /mi lus 'di la snying po cung yod srid/ /'on kyang 'gal rkyen bar chad grangs mang bas/ /rtag 'dzin blo la yid brtan ci zhig yod/ /19

bstod smon sems kyi sgra dbyangs/chos rgyal chen po'i chab srid gnam sa'i khyon/ / mkhan slob rnam gnyis nyi zla zung gis mdzes/ / gangs ljongs mun pa'i yul na rgyal bstan gyi/ /snang ba dam pas gsal bar mdzad la ston/ / chos tshigs yul dbus bsam yas dag pa'i zhing / / gdul ba'i sde 'dzin 'dab stong bzhad pas bkra/ /bslab gsum gtsang ma'i dri bsrung 'thul ba'i tshe/ / mkhan slob chos rgyal gsum gyi bka' drin dran/ / sngon byon dam pa'i srol bzang ma nyams par/ / bsam yas smon lam chen mo'i nyi gzhon de/ / slar yang 'dzum pas gangs can mkhas dgu rnams/ / pad+ma'i gling la bung ba'i khyu bzhin 'dus/ /rig pa'i gzhung lugs spyi dang bye brag la/ / dpyad pa gsum gyi sgo nas 'gran zhing gleng / / rig pa'i ngar skad dbyar rnga bsgrog pas na/ / blo ldan rma bya dga' spros yongs su smyos/ / da dung ma 'ongs dus kyi 'khor lo'i nang / / pha gcig bu 'dra'i ris med grub pa'i mtha'/ / dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin spel phyir bstan 'dzin rnams/ / thugs mthun khrims gtsang chos spyod gong 'phel ngang / / sku tshe mdzad 'phrin gong du 'phel bar smon/ /zhes bod rab byung 17shing sprel lo'i bsam yas smon lam chen mo'i skabs sbyar/20

gtam rgyud tasbra ra/sngo zhing dwangs ba'i rin chen 'byung gnas dbus/ / chu yi lang tshos btegs pa'i zla ba'i steng / / na phra'i ngang tshul ngom pa'i sgeg mo ma/ /dbyangs kyi rgyal mo mgrin pa'i khab tu bsu/ / srid gsum 'di na ma srid dgu srid srid/ / srid pa'i ltas mo rnam pa bco brgyad srid/ / srid tshad brjod pa'i khom pa ga na srid/ / cung zad rang gi 'dod bzhin brjod par spro/ / de yang 'dzam gling 'di yi phyogs shig na/ / nam mkha' bzhin du yangs pa'i rtswa thang steng / / me tog sna tshogs mtshan mo'i skar ltar bkra/ / bung ba'i glu dbyangs gling bu'i sgra las snyan/ / ri dwags rkyang dang sha ba dgo ba dang / /'phyi ba la sogs ji snyed mchis pa rnams/ /rtse 'jo 'dzad pa med pa'i gar la rol/ / ji tsam bltas kyang ngom pa'i skabs bral ba'i/ / gnas de byed pos pir gyis bris pa 'dra/ / yid 'ong rtsa thang sa bla sum rtsen gyi/ / skye mos tshal la skyengs ster de yi dbus/ / lus phra gzhon nu bcu drug lang tsho can/ /pad+ma'i bzhin la mig gi bung ba g.yo/ / phra zhing drang pa'i sku gzugs smyug ma la/ /'jam gnyen phyag gi lo ma rgyas pa yis/ / g.yang dkar lug phrug brang gi thad du 'dzin/ / be+estur zhun mas dbyug 'dra'i spang ljongs steng / / rkang chung gom pa'i 'degs 'jog dal bur bsgyur/ / mu tig sa la brdal 'dra'i bal ldan gyi/ / khyu tshogs mang po'i rjes su ded bzhin du/ / pad+ma dmar po 'dzum pa'i mchu sgros la/ / dkar mdzes tshems kyi ge sar ngom dang lhan/ /snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i glu dbyangs 'di ltar blangs/ / rtswa thang nam mkha' 'dra ba/ / me tog mtshan mo'i skar tshogs/ / nga dang g.yang dkar lug gu21

snang ba skyid pa'i rgyu red/ / bsil rlung dal bur rgyu ba/ / tsha gdung 'jom pa'i gnyen po/ / ri dwags mang po'i rtse 'jo/ / 'dren byed mig gi bdud rtsi/ / zhes pa'i glu dbyangs shes rab ldan mo yi/ / rgyud mang sgra yi gnyen por gyur pa de/ / su yang rung ba'i rna bar lhung 'gyur yang / / yid kyi brtan shor lus po 'dar sig sig / glang chen gros ma mo de'i nye phyogs su/ / bzhin ras nya gang zla ltar dkar zhing sgor/ / gsung skad tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang yang dag mtshungs/ / blo gros brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i rjes su 'gro/ / dpa' stobs srid med bu la 'gran nus pa'i/ / lug rdzi gzhon nu pho nyams ldan pa zhig mchis pa de yis glu dbyangs 'di blangs so/ / tshur cig tshur la gson dang / / dbyangs snyan glu len mdzes ma/ / mi yi bu mo yin nam/ / tshangs pa'i sras mo yin zhes/ / bdag blo 'phyang mo nyug so/ / de skad 'gran dung g.yas su 'khyil ba de/ / bud pa'i mod la na chung gzhon nu mar/ / rma byas dbyar rnga thos bzhin spro ba 'phel/ / yid 'ong sgeg mo'i longs spyod 'khor lo las/ / snyan 'jebs glu dbyangs mngar mo 'di ltar te/ / byad bzhin mgrin pa legs pa'i/ / pho gsar gzhon nu gson dang / / nga rang 'brog sde shar gyi/ / bu mo skal bzang sgron ma/ / pa pha bkra shis dpal ldan/ / a ma kun bzang dbang mo/ / zhes pa'i glu tshig mda' mo rdzi bo yi/ / snyan gyi dbang po'i 'ben la 'phen pa na/ / kho pa'i yid brtan brag ri thal bar brlags/ /lus po mi gnas la kha'i dar bzhin g.yo/ / de lta'i mod la smra ba'i sgo mo nas/ / glu dbyangs lha yi bdud rtsi 'di ltar thon/ / gson dang skal bzang sgrol ma gson/ / bdag go skal bzang rnam rgyal gyi/ / pha ni yon tan nor bu dang / / ma ni ye shes sgrol dkar yin/ / de ring yid 'ong gzhon nu ma/ /khyed dang 'jal ba skal ba bzang / / zhes pa'i sprin gyi sgra brgya grags pa na/ /sgeg mo sprin sgeg ma des lang tsho yi/ / mdong mtha' ngoms dang dga' ba'i 22

nyams 'gyur gyi/ / gar la rol bzhin gzhon nu'i gdong nas bsus/ / ne'u gsing g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal phyis 'dra'i dbus/ / dga' zhing lhan du rol ba'i gzhon nu gnyis/ / chu skyes pad+ma'i spo dang rkang drug ni/ / yin min bdag gi blo ni 'phyang mo nyug 'on kyang kho gnyis phan tshun glu dbyangs kyi/ / me tog sil ma gtor res byed bzhin du/ / so so'i lo rgyus brjod pa sogs pa yi/ /gtam gyi gsung snyan rol mo 'khrol bzhin gnas/ / de'i mur snang byed dbang po rlung gi rta/ / chibs te nub ri'i rgyab tu phebs la nye/ / byang skar spun bdun byang la phebs pa dang / / skar ma smin drug nub la bzhud 'gro ltar/ / gzhon nu gnyis kyang bal ldan khyu ded de/ / rang rang khyim gyi phyogs su dal bur chas/ / sang nyin zhogs pa shar ri'i rtse mo nas/ / pad+ma'i gnyen gyis 'dzum zhal ngoms tsa na/ / slar yang gzhon nu gnyis po'i rkang chung gis/ / gom pa'i 'degs 'jog bsgyur te so so yi/ / lug khyu ded de rtsa thang thog tu 'byor/ / rdzi bo gzhon nu skal bzang rnam rgyal gyi/ / bzhin dkar zla ba shar ba'i de ma thag skal bzang sgron ma'i kun da rab tu 'dzums/ / dri zhim ngad ldan glu dbyangs 'di ltar blangs/ / phyags la phebs sam phebs sam/ / pho gzhon skal bzang rnam rgyal/ / kha sing bka' mol med kyang / /de ring slar yang mjal so/ / zhes pa'i glu dbyangs pi wang gling bu'i sgra/ /sgrags pas pho gzhon skal bzang rnam rgyal ko/ / ri dwags sgra la nyan pa'i rjes su mthun/ / skal bzang rnam rgyal lha lam yangs pa la/ dga' ba'i chu 'dzin sdug po 'khrigs pa las/ / snyan dbyangs sbrang char sil ma 'di babs so/ /phyag la phebs sam phebs sam/ / bu mo skal bzang sgron ma/ / ma gros mnyam du 'dzom pa/ / las kyis skul ba min nam/ / zhes pa'i glu yi me tog 'thor ba na/ / yan lag mchog ma skal bzang sgron ma yis/ / zur mig mda' mo smin ma'i gzhus bkang de/ / 'phangs pas pho gzhon skal bzang rnam rgyal gyi/ /23

rtse gnyis dogs pa'i ri bo rdul du brlag gzhon nu gnyis po'i blo sems gcig tu byas/ / brtse gdung dar gyi mdud pas dam du bcings/ / lang tshos dregs pa'i gzhon nu gnyis po la/ / dga' ba dbyar gyi mtsho ltar ches cher rgyas/ / spro ba'i chang gis spyos pa'i gzhon zung gis/ / dus tshod mi gnas glog gi rjes 'gro bar/ / lta ba'i dran shes rnyed pa'i khom pa dben/ /nyin brtsegs zla rdzogs zla brtsigs lo rdzogs te/ / bgrang bya du ma skad cig nyid la 'das/ / skal bzang sgron ma'i snyan grags kun la khyab/ / ma legs mi bzang dus kyi nyin mo zhig skal bzang sgron ma'i bde skyid pad+ma'i tshal/ /'jom phyir 'brog sde byang gi phyogs rol nas/ / rdo rgyal zhes bya'i rgyal po phag rgod dang / / mtshungs shig gom 'gros 'brog sde shar la bsgyur/ / skal bzang sgron ma'i khyim gyi nang du 'dzul/ / skal bzang sgron ma'i pha ma gnyis po dang / / rgas po rdo rgyal lhan du gros pa'i mthar/ / ri dwags mig can skal bzang sgron ma ko/ / rgas po'i bu yi bag mar rdzong zhes gros/ / gtong lugs skal bzang sgron ma'i lkog gyur du/ / gsang ba'i sgo nas grabs sgrig byas tshar rjes/ / gnyen sgrig rten 'brel sgrig rgyur gros thag bcad/ / sta gon tshar rjes gza' skar 'byung 'phrod legs/ / tshes cha bzang ba'i dus kyi zhogs pa zhig / skal bzang sgron mar 'brog sde byang gi phyogs/ / rdo rgyal tshang gi bu yi khyim 'dzin mar/ / 'gro dgos zhes pa'i btsan bka'i ser ba phabs/ / skal bzang sgron ma'i sems kyi lo tog bcom/ / de lta'i mod la mo yi lus po la/ /zab 'chor klub dang rin chen rgyan la btags/ / rta la skyon nas bag ma skyel mi tshos/ / 'brog sde byang gi phyogs su khrid pa ni/ / dper na bya khras bye'u 'khyer ba bzhin/ / mya ngan smre ngag 'don pa kho na las/ / bya thabs gzhan pa gang yang med par gyur/ / yun ring ma song bag ma skyel mkhan dang / skal bzang sgron ma'i pha ma gnyis dang bcas/ / 'brog sde byang gi phyogs la dngos 24

su slebs/ / de nas kho tsho bag ma bsu mkhan gyi/ / gzhas pa gzhas ma bcas pas nang du bsus/ / gral gyi steng du phreng ba ltar du 'khod/ / gzhas pa gzhas mas glu dbyangs 'dzad med blangs/ / 'on kyang snyan par grags pa'i glu dbyangs dag / skal bzang sgron ma'i rna bar lhung ma thag / snying la mdung rtse btsugs ltar gzug gzer langs/ / da dung kho mo'i yid kyi dbang po yi/ / me long nang du skal bzang rnam rgyal gyi/ / rnam 'gyur sogs kyi gzugs brnyan wa ler gsal/ / drin can pha ma gnyis dang bral dgos pa'i/ / snang tshul mang po'ang mthong bas mig zung gi / sprin las mya ngan gyis bskul mig chu'i char/ / chil chil babs pas ngo gdong yongs su brlan/ / kha nas sdug skad mi snyan lhang lhang 'don/ / de'i tshe skal bzang sgron mar sdug bsngal dang / / rdo rgyal tshang gi bu la dga' ba gnyis/ / phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du lhan cig rgyas/ / nyin lnga song rjes rten 'brel mdzad sgo rdzogs/ / pha ma gnyis kyang log rgyu'i grabs sgrig byas/ / pha mas rang gi brtse ba'i bu mo la/ / bslab bya'i tshig gi mtha' ma 'di smras so/ / ka ye snying gi bu mo ma g.yeng bar/ / nged gnyis pha ma'i bslab bya tshig gsum nyon/ /rgan rabs rnams la sems chung gus zhabs dang / / skye bo kun dang mthun sgril dam zab dgos/ / rnam kun las la 'bad pa lhur len byos/ / de skad pha ma'i bslab tshig mtha' ma yin/ ma brjed snying gi nang du 'dzin par mdzod/ / da ni bu mo bde bar sdod cig ang / / zer nas kho gnyis 'gro bar brtsams pa na/ / na chung bu mo skal bzang sgron ma ni/ / skyo ba mi zad pa yi nyes pas mnar/ / dran med mun pa'i klong na re zhig lus/ / slar yang dran pa'i snang ba rnyed pa'i tshe/ / pha ma gnyis dang rdo rgyal la sogs pas/ / 'jam snyan tshig gi sems gso mang mang byed/ / de rjes skal bzang sgron ma'i pha ma gnyis/ / rta la bzhon nas rim bzhin phar phar chas/ bu mos pha ma'i rjes su 25

bya ra byed/ / pha ma mi mngon gnam sa'i mtshams su yal/ / skal bzang sgron ma'i smra ba'i babs stegs las/ / skyo ba'i smre ngag tshigs bcad 'di smras so/ / kye ma kye hud drin can yab yum bral/ / snying gi chung grogs skal bzang rnam rgyal bral/ / rang dbang med par gzhan dbang kho na yis/ / cha rgyus med pa'i yul phyogs 'dir slebs pa/ / las ngan gang gis lan pa yin nam ci/ / a tsi bu mo nga yi skyo ba ang / / zhes pa'i tshig gi smre ngag 'don bzhin gnas/ / pho gsar gzhon nu skal bzang rnam rgyal ni/ / nyin ltar rtswa thang g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal dang / / mtshungs pa de yi phyogs su bskyod na yang / / snying grogs dga' ma skal bzang sgron ma nyid/ / 'dren byed mig gi yul du ma gyur pas/ / kho bo'i sems pa nam mkha' stong pa'i dbyings/ / rnam rtog mang po'i rlung dmar drag tu 'khrugs/ / thengs cig rtswa thang yangs po de yi steng / / 'brog sde shar gyi phyogs nas phebs pa yi/ / rdzi bo rgas po zhig dang ngo phrad pas/ / kho yis rgas po'i snyan la 'di ltar smras/ / ka ye bgres song bdag la gson/ / 'brog sde shar na zhugs pa yi/ / bu mo skal bzang sgron ma de/ / sku khams bzang po yin nam ci/ / de skad rgas po'i rna bar lhung ma thagargas pos gzhon nu'i mgo nas mjug gi bar/ / mig gnyis cer nas legs par bltas byas te/ / dri ba'i tshig gi lan smras 'di lta ste/ / na chung bu mo skal bzang sgron ma ni/ / nyid kyi pha mas 'brog sde byang gi phyogs/ / btsan po'i sgo nas bag mar brdzangs zhes thos/ / da lta'i gnas tshul bdag gis ma shes so/ / zhes pa'i tshig gi dug can mda' mo de/ / kho yi sgra 'dzin dbang por phog pas na/ / ci bya gtol pa med par yud cig lus/ / dar tsam song rjes dbugs ring dbyung bzhin du/ / yid chad gyur pa'i gtam 'di rgas por smras/ / bgres song re zhig bdag la dgongs/ / nga dang skal bzang sgron ma gnyis/ / lo 'ga'i sngon nas phan tshun du/ / brtse ba'i dung sems 26

sprod res byas/ / tshe gcig mnyam dga' mnyam skyid kyi/ / 'tsho bar rol rgyu'i g.yar dam bcas/ / bgrangs bya du mar yid 'ong gi / spang 'di'i steng du lhan cig rol/ / dga' spro'i dpal la longs su spyad/ / 'on kyang de ring bgres song gi / zhal nas mi snyan gtam de 'dra/ / thos pas bdag gi khog pa'i snying / / gas ltar zug rngu mi zad 'phel/ / de 'dra'i tshig de thos ma thagang ni hang sang hon yang 'thor/ / kye ma/ / 'jig brten srid pa'i chos la/ / yid brtan gang yang mi 'dug / yun ring bcangs pa'i brtse gdung / / me tog sad kyis bcoms bzhag / zhes pa'i smre ngag rgas pos go bas na/ / gzhon nu'i yid kyi gdung ba sel ba'i phyir/ / sems gso'i tshig gi zla zer spro bar dgongs/ / drang gtam rgas po'i nyams myong 'di smras so/ / gzhon gzhon gzhon nu rgas po'i phyogs la gson/ / 'jig rten 'jig rten zhes pa'i 'khor ba 'dir/ / chung chung byis pa'i dus nas slebs pa yin/ / rgas rgas mgo dkar ma gyur bar du bsdad/ / mang mang bya ba ma byas gang yang med/ / thob thob 'di zhes gang yang bstan du med/ / bde ba bde ba zhes pa'i gtam snyan po/ / thos thos rna bas lan mang thos na yang / /dngos dngos rjen rjen bde ba 'di yin zhes/ / tag tag gtan gtan gang yang bstan du med/ / sdug bsngal sdug bsngal zer ba'i nyes pa de/ / phar phar spangs kyang tshur tshur shor nas yong / / srid gsum 'khor ba dug can sbrul gyi tshang / / bde ba 'dod pa sdod pa'i gnas ma yin/ / pho gzhon khyed kyi sdug bsngal 'di 'dra ba/ / 'jig rten 'di na rtse ba'i yul las 'das/ / bu bu myang ngan ma byed bdag la nyon/ / da lta'i sdug bsngal rtswa rtse'i zil pa tsam/ / 'byung rgyu'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho chen po'i klong / / da lta'i ngal ba khyad du bsad byas te/ / 'byung rgyu'i sdug bsngal bzlog pa'i thabs soms shigade skad smras rjes gzhon nu rgas po gnyis/ / so sor gyes nas rang rang khyim la 27

mi dpon ngo chen phrad pa'i snyan ngag yod/ /sprel lad ngo bstod dga' ba'i tshig tshogs yin/ /mtha' gru yul ljongs mthong ba'i snyan ngag yod/ /'char snang 'ud kyis rgyan pa'e tshig tshogs yin/ /ya rabs dam par bstod pa'i snyan ngag yod/ /mkhas pa mig dper ston pa'i tshig tshogs yin/ /ma rab khram par smad pa'i snyan ngag yod/ /ngan spyod sna tshogs dgag pa'i tshig tshogs yin/ /'byor med dbul phongs zhig gi snyan ngag yod/ /mthong chung brnyas bcos myang pa'i tshig tshogs yin/ /phugs bsam snying la bcangs pa'i snyan ngag yod/ /bsam 'dun kha nas thal ba'i tshig tshogs yin/ /snying gtam drang gtam brjod pa'i snyan ngag yod/ /legs nyes blang 'dor 'byed pa'i tshig tshogs yin/ /g.yo can khram pa zhig gi snyan ngag yod/ /yang dag bden don snyon pa'i tshig tshogs yin/ /shes med glen pa zhig gi snyan ngag yod/ /gzhan smras skyar bzlos byed pa'i tshig tshogs yin/ /shes ldan mkhas pa zhig gi snyan ngag yod/ /tshig snyan don zab drang po'i tshig tshogs yin/ /phyogs dang ris su lhung pa'i snyan ngag yod/ /gang yang rang phyogs bstod pa'i tshig tshogs yin/ /chos pa rnal ma zhig gi snyan ngag yod/ /sems dwangs nyon mongs zhi ba'i tshig tshogs yin/ /43

kha btags dkar po/kha btags dkar po'i mdog la bltas pa'i tshe/ /bod kyi gangs ri dkar po yid la 'khor/ /gangs ri dkar po 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan/ /kha btags dkar po'i reg byar bltas pa'i tshe/ /bod mi'i gshis ka 'jam po yid la 'khor/ /gshis ka 'jam po mi yi rgyan cha red/ /kha btags dkar po'i srid la ltas pa'i tshe/ /bod mi'i ngang rgyud ring po yid la 'khor/ /ngang rgyud ring po mi yi spyod bzang red/ / kha btags dkar po'i dbyibs la bltas pa'i tshe/ /brtse gdung dar gyi mdud pa yid la 'khor/ // lhad med brtse gdung mi yi la rgya red/ /kha btags dkar po'i ri mor bltas pa'i tshe /bod kyi shes rig sna tshogs yid la 'khor/ /shes bya rig gnas mi yi yon tan red/ /kha btags dkar po dgung sngon dbyings su 'phyar/ /'dzam gling zhi bde yong ba'i smon 'dun zhu/ / pro snelnguju ri'isgrub slo

'dra re che/dgung sngon gyi ser 'od stong ldan de/ /nga'i mtshar ldan bla ma 'dra re che/ /rje drin can bla ma'i byin rlabs de/ /khyon sa gzhi 'di na ma khyab med/ /dgung sngon gyi zla ba'i bsil zer de/ /nga'i drin can pha ma 'dra re che/ /drin zla med pha ma'i bka' drin de/ /nged gzhon skyes gzhon nu'i gdung sel yin/ /dgung sngon gyi skar tshogs khra chil de/ /nga'i mched grogs spun rnam 'dra re che/ /grogs spun mched bzang po'i rin thang de/ /gser rin chen dang po'i do zla min/ /dgung sngon gyi 'ja' mtshon mdzes bkra de/ /nga'i sems kyi lha mo 'dra re che/ /lha tshangs pa'i sras mo dbyangs can ma/ /nga'i snyan ngag kun gyi 'byung rtsa yin / /45

dbyangs bzhi/gi gu lha yi phyag mdzub dgung la ker/ /legs lam bya bzang mtha' dag 'tshol zhib byed/ /zhabs kyu sgo nga phyed gnyis cha bsgrigs nas/ /shes+t+ra bya'i tshang n+d+ra khyung phrug bsnyal bar sdu/ /trīsna dī byā dz+nyo byi~Xnā dṛkālda phyutrī nā nār+sha /ga / /na ro rgod po'i gshog pa mkha' la brkyangs/ /gzhung lugs la klung kun la lta bzhin bskor/ /da 46

gsal byed sum cu/gsal byed sum cu'i snyan dbyangs je dma' ru 'gro zhing / /gsal byed sum cu'i bya ba je nyung du 'gyur dus/ /gsal byed sum cu'i zhing khams stong pa ru 'gyur nas/ /gsal byed sum cu 'das pa'i lo rgyus la 'gyur nges/ /gsal byed sum cus bskyangs pa'i gangs can gyi skye bos/ /gsal byed sum cu spel bar ra mda' zhig med na/ /gsal byed sum cu'i byed po thon mi yi thugs pham/ /gsal byed sum cus brjod kyang go mkhan yang med 'gro /gsal byed sum cu'i byed po thon mi yi dka' spyad/ /gsal byed sum cus bris kyang shes mkhan yang med 'gro /47

gab chig khag bzhi/sngo zhing dwangs pa'i rin chen 'byung gnas dbus/ /chu yi lang 'tshos btegs pa'i zla ba'i steng / /na phra'i ngang tshul ngoms pa'i sgeg mo ma/ /zla ba'i spun du gyur pa'i lha mo su/ /bram ze rgyu skar rnams kyi rje bor bkod/ /'jug pa bcu pa'i gtsug gi rgyan dam pa/ /dkar zhing 'tsher ba'i 'dzum zhal 'jig rten gyi/ /skye bo rnams la ngoms mkhan mdzes sdug ldan/ /don rgyud 'brug pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /gzhung lugs 'bum phrag mkhyen pa'i paṇa ṭi ta/ /me long la 'jug bshad sbyar dan+ḍi yi/ /dgongs rgyan mdzad po mkhas pa su yin nam/ /blo gros ldan pa'i lha yi bla mar gyur/ /snyan ngag smra la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i gza' chen brgyad po yi/ /ya gyal de su de ming ci yin nam/ /48

dung sgra/ dung / khyed ni nga dang nga'i rang gshis/dam chos tshogs 'khor 'du na tshogs dung /zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul na mchod dung /drag po'i g.yul 'khrugs gsham na dmag dung /dgra chu srin phrad na dung dkar/shi yang sgra skad tsha ba'i dung /nga'i gshis lugs thams cad dung /nga'i snyan ngag thams cad dung sgra/snyan 'jebs kyi dung sgra min na yang /nga'i sems kyi mchod sprin kho na yin/snyan 'jebs kyi dung sgra min na yang /nged gangs phrug gzhon nu'i snying stobs yin/dung sgra/ dung sgra 'dis srid gsum khyab par smon/ /— 49

rgya mtsho dang ded dpon chung chung /chung chung byis pa'i rgyab tu 'khur pa'i dpe khug chung chung /ji 'dra'i snying rje po dang rtsa chen zhig red ang /ma 'ongs pa'i re ba dang / mdun lam/'byung 'gyur thams cad de'i nang du yod la/de'i nang nas len kyang chogadape khug chung chung /ljikā sdi / /che la gting zab pa'i rin chen nor bu'i 'byung gnas/chung chung dpe khug rgyab tu khur ba'i byis pa chung chung /ji 'dra'i gzi brjid dang rlabs chen zhig red ang /ma 'ongs pa'i mdzes sdug dang / spro snang /'byung 'gyur thams cad de'i yin la/ des spyad kyang chogabyis pa chung chung /khyed ni ma 'ongs pa'i thams cad kyi bdag po red yā/ ////ji / sa 4((1 sa tshotsho shā tsho ci choca — skeri50

grwa rkyang tsho/grwa rkyang tsho/ ches thog ma'i grwa rkyang tsho/dras shing drub pa'i gos rnam gsum dang /nyin re'i gsol snyoms kyis 'tsho yang /ston pa chen po'i gzi byin gyi mthus/bya btang gi spyod pa/ ting gsal gyi sgom pa/bag yangs pa'i sems khams la brten nas/rdzogs mtha' med pa'i dga' bde la spyod/grwa rkyang tsho/ gna' rabs kyi grwa rkyang tsho/dben sa ri khrod 'grim zhing /dka' sdug dang / ngan ngon zas kyis 'tsho yang /ston pa chen po'i rjes 'jug mkhas grub tsho'i gzi byin gyi mthus/thos bsam la 'bad/ sgom sgrub la gzhol/lus ngag yid gsum dben pa la bsten nas/rdzogs mtha' med pa'i dga' bde la rol/grwa rkyang tsho/ deng rabs kyi grwa rkyang nga dang 'dra ba tsho/rin thang can gyi gos gyon/ro bcud ldan pa'i zas kyis 'tsho yang /ston pa chen po'i gzi byin phra ba dang /51

dus snyigs ma'i ngan rtags dbang btsan pas/thos bsam gyi snying po dgag sgrub tsam po ba/chos kyi sems pa nyon mongs dug gsum gyis bzi/lus ngag yid gsum 'du 'dzi la bsten pas/bag 'khums kyi sems pa sdug bsngal gyis mnar/ /rici tsho ‘ ///// )sni trīd+kuri— tshotsho 3 nyicilcoci / bar〉ciriskuri〈 / — 7 ’ 7po〉 ririsarica —chi4 hūṃ~X/dzā cha—rī — rdo r+sha —kroshā+o rme ’ (shā39tre du ci ) ༄༷ phyo tre 3༷kyā —tsho / rdoX ri skari juzang / — / sku4sh+lau tsā hūṃ kyi )pre trīriririr/snye 93 ci 〉trī ciri )riririri ne+ebyeri citsho rnyi)ricisnyu cari༄ri 52

brtse gdung gi gshed ma/g.yo zol med pa'i mdza' grogs dwangs ma tsho/phan tshun bltos pa'i yid ches kyi brlan gsher ma skam bar/brtse gdung gi me tog rang byung dang /bde skyid kyi 'bras bu lhan skyes red/yid ches/ yid ches kyi mdzes sdug ni/brtse gdung gi me tog sos pa'i spro snang red/de 'dra'i mdzes sdug dang spro snang / a khā/g.yo sgyu dang brdzun gtam gyi than pa tsha drag pas/yid ches kyi chu mig skam/brtse gdung gi me tog yal/sdug bsngal gyi mu ge langs/g.yo sgyu dang rdzun gtam/ brtse gdung gi gshed ma/ngan 'bras 'gog thabs med pa g.yo dang rdzu/gtam gyi byas nyes dang gdug tsub/ /53

sgor mo'i gtam/sgor mo la 'phya ba skye bo kun gyi kha/sgor mo la dga' ba skye bo kun gyi sems/sgor mo/ deng dus kyi sgor mo'i gleng phyogs ni/ya mtshan can gyi mtshar gtam zhiga.a ā/ sgor mor 'phya bzhin sgor mo'i ched du rgyugahe he/ sgor mor 'phya smod byed pa tsho/da dung / nga tshos so so ngo shes kyi mi 'dugasgor mo/ sgor mo ni gzhan 'gyur te/bzang dang phrad na bzang /ngan dang phrad na ngan/sgor mo/ dmar dmar gyi sgor mo/khyed la bstod smad gang yang 'os /54

lus dang sems/lus/bya bzhag med pa'i sdug bden gyi lus po/khyed la gces spras byed don ci/ bde ba'i ched du yā/he he/ rtag brtan gyi bde ba ci zhig yod/cha bzhag med pa'i sdug bden gyi lus po/ khyed la gces spras byed don ci/sems/snying stobs med pa'i bde 'dod kyi sems pa/la kha'i dar lce/bsil ljongs gyi rlung po ldang dus/khyod lhab lhub tu g.yo/drag char shag shag du babs tshe/dar rgyug la thim pa'i khyed/lam 'gro med pa'i tshong pa mgo bde zhig /55

me lce/bsam med byis dus kyi 'tsho ba tshor snang dang bral/bsam gzhig thub pa'i lang 'tsho gsar du brnyes pa nas bzung /bsam gzhig re re 'khor dus/ 'gran rtsod kyi me lce re 'bar/bsam gzhig zhib phra thub pa'i lang 'tsho yongs su rdzogs dus/thams cad 'gran rtsod kyi me lce ste/'gran rtsod kyi me lce re re'i rtse nas/ dga' skyid gong 'phel gyi drod khol dang / nyams nyes sdug bsngal gyi du ba ci yang 'ong / yin na'ang / me lce la yod dgos pa drod khol dang / me lce la med dgos pa du ba yin na/ de gnyis la dgag bsgrub ji ltar byed/o'o/ kun slong gi bud shing la bsam ngan gyi brlan gsher med na/ du ba med pa'i me lce dwangs ma/ khams gtsang / drod che/ yid gar 'ong / 'on kyang / bsam pa'i bud shing de dug gsum gyi chus brlan na/ du ba 'dren pa'i me lce nag po des/ sdug skad dang mig chu/ mdor na/ sdug po dbang med du gtong bar nges/ sna rmo (sgyu rmo56

dran gdung gi 'bod sgra/'das zin pa'i dus tshod la phyir dran re byed dus/nga'i mig lam du lham mer snang ba ni/nga'i sems nang bag chags zab shos kyi grogs po ste/'jams dbyang seng ge lags/nged gnyis kyi gtam rgyud ni/ lhad med kyi grogs po/nam yang 'gyur med kyi grogs po/nga'i sems nang da dung yang lhang nger snang ba ni/khong gi snying stobs dang rnam dpyod/ rgod 'dzum/sgam brling gi spyod pa/phugs bsam gleng ba'i bka' mol sogs yin/khong gis nga la bzhag pa'i bag chags zab pas/nga khong gis las dbang la yid ma ches nas/ku re dang 'dres pa'i rtsod pa zhig 'dzugs par 'dod/rgod 'dzum gyi ngang nas gsol ja zhig 'bul bar 'dod/'on kyang / grogs dam pa'i las dbang dngos yod du song bas/nga la thob pa ni skyo snang dang yid chad/grogs mchog lags/ 'jam dbyangs seng ge lags/ngas khyod la bsngags brjod kyi me tog dbul bzhin 'bod kyin yod/ /57

kho gnyis gnyis ka pham song /ka pa/ de ring pho gzhon gnyis rgyag res thug song /kha pa/ 'o na kho gnyis su pham song ngam/ka pa/ kho gnyis gnyis ka pham song /kha pa/ rgyag res brgyab na phan tshun gcig pham nas gcig la rgyal kha thob kyi red/ gnyis ka pham zer ba lugs srol la yod dogs med/ka pa/ 'o na khyod rang nyon dang / de ring mi de gnyis kyis rgyag res brgyab nas shi min ro min ma chags par 'thab 'dzing byas pas kho gnyis gnyis ka la nyes brdungs tshad med phog song / de ma thag yang nyen rtogs pa yong nas kho gnyis mi re la nyes chad sgor lnga brgya lnga brgya btang song bas kho gnyis gnyis ka la gyong ma gtogs khe mi 'dug byas tsang kho gnyis gnyis ka pham pa ma red dam/ zhes bshad pas kha pa gang yang bshad rgyu med par gyur/ /58

gra nang gi mkhas pa mi bzhi/g.yo ru gra yi mkhas pa rim byon garga'i klung gi bye ma snyed/ / skye chen bcu gsum mkhas pa mi bzhi'i grags pa'i 'od zer cher 'bar bas/ / nam mkha'i nor bu skyengs rang drags te nub ri'i rgyab la 'jabs pa dang / /mkhas pa mi bzhis bag chags bzang po'i legs skyes phul tshul 'di na brjod/ / mkhas pa'i dbang phyug dam rtser bsgyur pa phugu ༵ dpūl mgīn 'asdin las kyis/ / gra dkar 'cha' ba'i bzo grwa btsugs te phul byung zhal dkar legs skyes phul/ / bzo rig kun la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba 'dum spya don grus dbyāng rgyas gyis/ / gra sbub spus gtsang bzo grwa btsugs te gsung snyan rol mo legs skyes phul/ / rig pa'i rtsal la 'gran zla bral ba sri myu raṭā btun dbyāng sdo yis/ / rdza rigs sna tshogs bzo grwa btsugs te khyad 'phags rdza dung legs skyes phul/ / shes rab rnam dpyod mkha' ltar yangs pa gasdung tha5 byā badz+wang mgīn sdo yis/ / gra dngul btso ba'i bzo grwa btsugs te ṭam ka dkar po legs skyes phul/ / shes bya rig pa'i gzhung lugs kun la mkhyen pa rgyas pa'i blo gros can/ / gzhan don bya ba lhur len mdzad mkhan gra nang mkhas pa mi bzhi yi/ / ngo mtshar yon tan rgya mtsho'i dbus nas chu thigs tsam zhig 'di na ko/ / sngon byon rgas po'i zhal rgyun ji bzhin yi ger cung zad phab pa'o /2rkya01 10 1nyin/59

mchan/ (1)phug pa dpal mgon 'phrin las ni gra nang du phug pa ba'i khyim rgyud du 'khrungs/ gra nang gi skye chen bcu gsum gyi gras bde gling rin chen dpal bzang zhes pa sdings che'i cog grwa'i sku phreng dang po sems dpa' rin chen dpal bzang po'i yab kyi sku mched lnga yod pa'i nang gi bgres shos de yin zhing / gzhung lugs spyi dang lhag par khyim rgyud kyi rig gnas bzo rtsis sngags gsum la shin tu mkhas pa'i rab byung btsun pa zhig yin/ bsgrags rgyal byed tshal sogs su slob ma mang / de bzhin 'brug pa'i kun mkhyen chen po pad+ma dkar po dang / sdings che'i cog grwa sku phreng dang po'i bshes gnyen kyang yin/ da dung dkar yol gyi bzo grwa btsugs te gra dkar sogs bca' dngos mang po gsar bzo dang thon skyed gnang / yin na'ang phug pa dpal mgon 'phrin las ma byon pa'i gong nas mkhas grub gan dkar zhes pa'i dkar yol gyi bzo rgyun zhig yod pa lung las gsal/ phug pa dpal mgon 'phrin las kyi sku thang rnying pa da lta sdings po cher dngos su mjal rgyu yod/(2)'dum po don grub dbang rgyal ni gra nang gi phu nor po ('dum po )zhes pa'i lung pa der 'khrungs/ tha snyad pa'i rig gnas kun la mkhas pa'i mkhas dbang byang chub sems dpa' khyim pa'i tshul la gnas pa zhig yin zhing /smin gling gter bdag gling pa'i yum lha 'dzin dbyangs can sgrol ma'i yab chen dang gter bdag gling pa'i 'bri klog slob pa'i slob dpon yang yin/ da dung rin chen bzhu brdung gi bzo grwa btsugs te gra sbug dang gra dril sogs rin chen khyad du 'phags pa'i bca' dngos du ma gsar gtod thon skyed gnang bar grags/ 'dum po zhes pa'i lung pa der deng sang nor po zhes zer ba de dus dbang gis sgra 'gyur ba yin nges/gzhan yang rtsom yig 'di'i nang rtags lho'adis 'khrungs sa'i gnas dang / rtags 0'dis mtshan gsal bar byas pa bcas yin/ /60

snyan ngag don rgyan so lnga'i dper brjod gzhon nu'i lam zhes pa'i mtshams spyor rag bsdus/'dir snyan ngag rgyan so lnga'i dper brjod gzhon nu'i lam zhes pa de'i mtshams sbyor rags bsdus shig zhus na/ de la don rnam pa gsum ste/ snyan ngag de 'bri ba'i dmigs yul/ de'i rtsom stangs/ de'i nang don gyi skor cung zad gleng ba bcas gsum yod pa las/dang po/ snyan ngag don rgyan so lnga'i dper brjod gzhon nu'i lam zhes pa de 'bri ba'i dmigs yul ni/ rang nyid snyan ngag la mkhas par bya ba dang /bod kyi srol rgyun snyan ngag mi nyams gong 'phel yong ba dang / snyan ngag me long ma'i nang nas bstan pa'i don rgyan so lnga so so'i nang gses dang bcas pa'i dper brjod nyis brgya lhag yod pa de dag re re la rang rang gi khyad chos re yod pa shes phyir dang / snyan ngag sbyong mkhan tshos kyang snyan ngag sbyangs pa'i zhor la bod kyi yul skor khor yug gi rnam pa brjid chags ya mtshan pa dag dang / rgyal rabs lo rgyus/ gna' bo'i nyams 'gyur/ deng rabs kyi rnam pa/ dmangs srol goms gshis sogs kyi skor la mkhyen rtogs yong phyir dang / snyan ngag slob khrid gnang mkhan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnam pas brgya go gcig chod kyi sgo nas rig gzhung rgyud sprod byed pa'i ched rtsom gang mang spel rgyu'i re ba yang mtshon par byas pa bcas yin/gnyis pa/ snyan ngag de'i rtsom stangs ni tshigs bcad lhug spel ma'i 61

sgrung gtam gyi khongs su gtogs pa zhig yin zhing / de'i nang gi mi sna gtso bo gzhon nu legs sbyin dang ngag mdzes gnyis ni rtsom pa po rang gi thabs dang shes rab gnyis dpe'i gzugs su bkod pa yin la/ gzhon nu gnyis kyi bu de ni rtsom pa po rang gis thabs shes zung 'brel gyis brtsams pa'i snyan ngag don rgyan so lnga'i dper brjod gzhon nu'i lam zhes pa de dpe'i gzugs su bkod pa bcas byas te rtsom de'i phyi nang bar gsum du snyan ngag gi nyams 'gyur mngon par byas yod/gsum pa/ snyan ngag de'i nang snyan ngag me long ma'i dper brjod la 'grel bshad byed stangs gsar pa zhig spyad yod pa ni skabs bab kyi 'grel bya'i dper brjod gang yin de'i go don dper brjod de ka'i mgo mjug bar gsum gang rung du rtsom yig de'i nang don dang mthun par byas nas bris yod pa de yin/ da dung de'i nang bod kyi yul khams khor yug gi rnam pa gangs ri dang rdza ri/ brag ri dang nags ri/ sgrub gnas dang brag phug rtswa thang /mtsho dang mtshe'u/ gtsang po/ dben gnas dang dgon pa/ lha khang dang pho brang / grong khyer sogs kyi rnam pa dang rig gnas dang 'tsho thabs te/ srol rgyun gyi yul srol goms gshis dper na/ skar ma ri byi la chu brgal ba dang /rkyang phyag 'tshal ba dang / zhogs pa snga po nas gling skor la 'gro ba sogs kyi phan yon/ shes bya rig gnas la sbyangs brtson byas pa'i phan yon dang ma byas pa'i nyes skyon/ bod kyi mi rigs dang rig gnas thog mar ji ltar byung ba'i skor gyi lo rgyus dang rtsom pa po so so'i lta tshul/ de bzhin rang byung gi sman rtsa gangs dkar 'chi med (garga chu )kyi gtam rgyud lta bu dmangs khrod kyi shod rgyun dang chang gzhas/ ngal rtsol gyi glu gzhas la sogs pa bkod nas bod ljongs la zhib 'jug gnang mkhan tshor zhabs 'degs zhu gang thub byas pa'i thog gangs can pa'i mes po'i snying stobs dang rnam dpyod/ lhag bsam dang 62

mdzad rjes sogs la bsngags brjod lan mang zhu bzhin du rtsom pa po zhig gi 'gan 'khri ste/ 'byung 'gyur la kha phyogs pa'i sems dbus kyi snying gtam mang po snyan ngag gi lam nas drangs te zhus pa bcas yin/ snyan ngag gi deb chung 'di'i nang brjod pa'i bod kyi yul khams/ khor yug gi rnam pa dang /rig gnas lo rgyus sogs kyi ngo mtshar brjid chags ya mtshan pa gang dag ji snyed cig bkod yod pa de dag ni rtog bzo min par gangs can pa'i yul du mig gis mthong la lag pas reg rgyu yod pa sha stag yin/ 'on kyang de dag re re'i ming nas smos pa la gangs can pa'i yul du gcig las gcig lhag pa'i gnas bzang dang gna' shul/ lo rgyus dang rig gnas sogs shin tu mang bas de dag re re'i ming nas smos ma spob par dpes mtshon par byas pa tsam yin khul lags/ yin na'ang/ rang gis bsam pa ltar don la gnas min bdag gis kyang cha ma 'tshal bas skyon dang nor 'khrul ji snyid yod pa gdon mi za bas mkhyen ldan pas skyon sel bka' slob gang mang lhug rtsol yong ba'i re ba yang zhu bzhin mchis pa lags/ /63

spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur ni mi'i bsam pa'i 'gyur ba kho na yin/'dir bdag gis sems can spyi dang bye brag mi'i rigs kyi bde sdug la do snang dang sems 'khur byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshon phyir spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur la lta tshul cung zad gleng bar 'dod/de yang spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur ni mi'i rigs kyi spyi mthun gyi bsam pa'i dmigs tshad dang sems kyi 'khyer so'i rjes su phyogs pa ste/ mi phal che ba'i bsam pa'i dmigs tshad ni rang nyid kun las rgyal nas stobs 'byor dbang grags gang la'ang thogs pa med pa zhig byed rgyu de yin zhing / de'i ched du byung ba'i bsam pa'i 'khyer so ni dgra la 'khon sems dang gnyen la chags sems/ dgra 'dul gnyen skyongs kyi bya ba bzang ngan gyi mjug 'bras mi shes pa'i rmongs pa bcas sems la rgyun 'byams su gnas pa de yin/ de lta bu'i bsam blo'i 'khyer so des dbang byas te mi 'ga' zhig gis rang nyid kyi grub mtha' rgya bskyed gang tsam 'gro ba'i tshe/ da dung 'ur shob bshad pa sogs kyis sims 'dzul byas te spyi tshogs yongs la dbang sgyur dang 'pho 'gyur btang nas rang nyid la khe phan dang mtshan snyan thob thabs byed/ yang mi 'ga' zhig gis rang la srid kyi dbang cha dang go sa gang tsam thob pa'i tshe/ dbang shugs kyi sgo nas spyi tshogs yongs la dbang bsgyur dang 'pho 'gyur btang ste rang nyid la mtshan snyan thob 'dod byed/ de lta bu'i bsam tshul 'chang mkhan gyi skye bo rnams ni rgyu dang rig gnas dbang shugs bcas gsum ka 'dzoms pa'am/— gsum ka ma 'dzoms na'ang gang rung gcig med pa mi srid pas/ de dag gi 64

bya spyod la spyi tshogs yongs kyi 'pho 'gyur dang gnas stangs kyi 'gan nus gal chen ldan yod/ skye bo de tshos bya ba bzang ngan gang byas kyang spyi tshogs yongs la 'pho 'gyur nges can zhig thebs 'gro bas de tsho'i bya spyod la dbye zhib nan tan byed rgyu gal che/ da dung tshang mas ngan spyod la 'phya smod byed bzhin par rang nyid ngan spyod la zhugs 'gro ba dang / lhing 'jags kyi spyi tshogs la dga' zhing lhing 'jags la bsngags brjod yang yang byed kyang / lhing 'jags min pa'i bya spyod dang lhing 'jags min pa'i spyi tshogs kyi phyogs la dbang med du shor 'gro ba sogs ni mi rnams kyi bsam pa'i 'khyer so dang dmigs tshad la tshad gzhi dang tshod 'dzin ma thub pa de yin/mi'i bsam pa'i dmigs tshad dang bsam blo'i 'khyer so la tshad gzhi dang tshod 'dzin ma thub pas mi'i bya spyod la tshad gzhi dang tshod 'dzin med pa yin/ mi'i bsam tshul dang bya spyod la tshad gzhi dang tshod 'dzin med pa'i dbang gis spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur de yang mi'i bsam pa'i dmigs tshad ltar yong dka'/ dper na/ mi phal che ba'i bsam pa'i dmigs tshad ni bde skyid dang dbang grags dpal 'byor sogs gang ci'i thad mi gzhan las rang nyid la lhag pa thob 'dod de yin kyang / mi tshang mar de ltar yong gi med pa ma zad/mi'i bsam tshul de'i dbang gis spyi tshogs thog tshul min gyi 'gran rtsod dang 'khrugs slong / thal che ba'i bya spyod tha na grogs bza' tshang dang / pha ma bu phrug dge rgan dge phrug lta bu'i bar la'ang phan tshun gcig gis gcig gi lam bkag pa/ mgo gnon pa sogs gcig min gnyis min mang po thon dang thon mus yin pa lta bu red/der brten nga tshos spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur dang gnas stangs de dpal yon gong 'phel dang zhi bde lhing 'jags kyi phyogs la kha phyogs gtan 'khel byed dgos na/ nges par du mi'i bsam pa'i dmigs tshad dang 'khyer so/ bya 65

spyod bcas la tshad gzhi dang tshod 'dzin thub pa byed rgyu dmigs su 'dzin nas slob gso'i bya bzhag gi kha phyogs gtan 'khel byed dgos/ slob gso'i bya bzhag ni rnam pa 'dra min sna tshogs te/ snyan ngag klog deb dang / rig gzhung rgyud sprod kyi dpe deb/ glu gzhas/ sgrung gtam/ zlos gar/ bzang por gzengs bstod dang ngan par 'phya smod byed pa sogs shin tu mang /sngar song lo rgyus dang 'byung rgyu'i mdun lam gang la bsam kyang spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur ni mi'i bsam pa'i 'gyur ba kho na yin la/ spyi tshogs so so'i rnam pa 'dra min sna tshogs pa de dag ni spyi tshogs de'i steng gi mi'i spyi mthun gyi bsam pa kho na yin pas/ slob gso'i las rigs la mkhas dgos na/nges par du mi'i bsam pa'i dmigs tshad dang bsam blo'i 'khyer so la dbye zhib dang do snang nan tan byed rgyu gal 'gangs che/da dung spyi tshogs 'pho 'gyur gyi sgrub cha'i gleng phyogs mang po yod kyang gtso bo rang dbang dang bde skyid zer ba de gnyis yin/ de yang nga tshos rang dbang gi ched du 'bad brtson byed kyi yod la/ rang tshor rang dbang nges par du yod dgos/ yin na'ang nga tshos rang dbang gi ched du 'bad brtson byed pa'i sngon du rang dbang la ngos 'dzin gsal po dang tshad gzhi gtan 'khel byed dgos/ gal srid de ltar ma byung na snga mo'i rang dbang can gi dpon rigs 'ga'i thal cha che ba'i bya spyod de/ rang 'dod ltar thal cha che ba'i khrims bca' ba dang / las mir sdug las tshad med skul ba/ chung ma mang po btsan shed kyis bsu ba la sogs pa lta bu dang / rang dbang med pa'i dbul phongs dang bran g.yog tshos myang pa'i sdug sbyong dang ngal dub sogs ni rang dbang yod pa dang rang dbang med pa gnyis kyi he bag dang skyon cha de yin/yang nga tshos bde skyid kyi ched du 'bad brtson byed mus yin la/ nga tshor bde skyid de bas yod dgos/ yin na'ang bde skyid dang sdug bsngal gnyis ni 66

dbye ba 'byed dka' ba ste/ mi so so'i bsam tshul dang 'dod tshul mi 'dra bas mi 'ga' zhig gis bde bar 'dod pa de mi gzhan 'gas sdug bsngal du 'dod pa dang / mi gzhan gyis sdug bsngal du 'dod pa de mi 'gas bde bar 'dod pa sogs yod/ de'i phyir nga tshor sdug bsngal med pa'i bde skyid cig yod dgos kyang bde skyid la spyi mthun gyi ngos 'dzin gsal po zhig dang gtan 'khel ba'i tshad gzhi med pas/ mi chen po dang chung chung / phyug po dang dbul po/ dbang yod dang dbang med/ mkhas pa dang blun po/ mdor na mi tshang mar sdug bsngal re yod pa yin/ des na rang dbang dang bde skyid zer ba de gnyis la spyi mthun gyi tshad gzhi med pas mi'i bsam pa'i dmigs tshad dang bsam blo'i 'khyer so/ bya spyod sogs la tshod 'dzin byed mi thub/mi'i bsam pa'i dmigs tshad dang bsam blo'i 'khyer so/ bya spyod sogs la tshod 'dzin byed ma thub na/ spyi tshogs kyi 'pho 'gyur ni rang dgar 'gro ba las nga tshos kha phyogs sgyur thub pa zhig yin mi srid/ de'i phyir nga tshos spyi tshogs 'pho 'gyur gyi kha phyogs la tshod 'dzin dang phyogs ston byed dgos na nges par du mi'i bsam pa'i dmigs tshad dang bsam blo'i 'khyer so la tshad gzhi dang tshod 'dzin byed pa'i lag cha slob gso'i rmang gzhi te/ rig gnas la mthong chen byed rgyu ni spyi tshogs yongs dang khyim tshang gcig mi sger bcas tshang ma'i mdun lam nyag cig de yin pas/ gong gsal gyi gnad don de dag ni spyi tshogs yongs kyis do snang dang sems 'khur mdzad dgos pa zhig min nam snyam ste/ go med tshor med kyi sgo nas bsam tshul stong pa de yi ger bkod pa'i ched du dus tshod 'phro brlag btang ba ni spyi tshogs yongs la lhag bsam mtshon par byas pa tsam las dmigs yul gzhan gang yang med la phan nus kyang thon mi srid/ de yang /ma sbyangs mu cor smra ba'i snyoms chung ngas/ / 67

mjug bsdu ba'i gtam/rig gnas ni mi rigs kyi spyi nor yin la/ rig gnas la 'bad brtson dang srung skyob byed rgyu ni mi rigs thun mong gi 'gan 'khri yin pas/ der rten ngas kyang rang gi 'gan 'khri phrag tu blangs nas rig gzhung khag la sbyang pa byed zhor du rtsom yig 'dra 'bri gang thub byas te/ 〈sdings che dgon pa'i gnas yig〉dang / 〈snyan ngag don rgyan so lnga'i dper brjod gzhon nu'i lam 〉zhes pa'i deb chung khag gnyis dpar skrun byas zin par sdings che dgon dang 'brel yod khag nas bla na med pa'i bka' drin bstsal byung ba'i thugs rje snying 'jags zhu rgyu yin/da res yang 〈dung sgra 〉zhes pa'i deb chung 'di dpe skrun byed par bsam yas dgon pa'i dbu 'dzin legs bshad thogs med mchog nas cha tshang ba'i bka' drin bstsal byung bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/ ma zad dbu 'dzin legs bshad thogs med lags mchog nas/ da dung mi rigs dang rig gnas la phan pa'i bya bzhag dang dpe deb dpar skrun gnang mkhan sogs la rgyab skyor gnang rgyu'i skor gsungs byung bas de ni nged gzhon skyes tsho'i snying stobs kyi me lce spar ba'i mar khu rang yin pas de la mi rigs dang rig gnas la dga' zhen gnang mkhan tshos bsngags brjod kyi me tog cis mi 'bul/de bzhin sdings che'i dbu mdzad nges gsang bstan 'phel lags nas kun slong gnang ba ltar gra nang zho ra'i spo bo skal bzang bag bro lags nas kyang sgor 100rkyaganang byung bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu bcas 70
